findings.issue: Render-time page clamp (Math.min) can leave the URL claiming a page the view doesn't show after filters shrink the result set
findings.suggestion: Clamp inside validateSearch, or replace-navigate to the clamped page when totalPages shrinks

findings.issue: data.ts is a 455-line god module containing every page's view-model builder and five module-level caches
findings.suggestion: Split into per-page builders (lib/data/home.ts, pokemon.ts, …) with the shared caches in their own module

findings.issue: The home loader ships the entire 1025-species catalog to the client in the SSR payload
findings.suggestion: Either filter server-side via server-fn params, or accept and document the tradeoff (payload size scales with the dataset, which the tests are allowed to grow)

findings.issue: <title> is rendered in the body of the not-found component rather than declared in head(); works because React 19 hoists it, but is non-idiomatic
findings.suggestion: Set the title via the root route's head() or a head on the notFound boundary, and drop the inline <title>

findings.issue: NotFoundPage is registered twice: as defaultNotFoundComponent on the router and notFoundComponent on the root route
findings.suggestion: Keep only the root route's notFoundComponent (it also covers matched-route notFound() throws)

findings.issue: Loader data is typed any across the server-fn boundary and restored with a manual `as CatalogEntry[]` cast, discarding the VM interfaces
findings.suggestion: Type the server-function handler's return value so useLoaderData carries the type

findings.issue: EM_DASH is exported but never used; em dash literals are written inline elsewhere
findings.suggestion: Delete the export or use it at the call sites

findings.issue: Search input triggers a replace-navigation on every keystroke with no debounce
findings.suggestion: Debounce up to the 300ms the spec allows to avoid re-render/navigate churn on long queries

summary: A well-executed TanStack Start 1.169 app that is fully on-idiom with the current stable APIs (shellComponent, .validator(), nitro/vite, server fns in loaders, notFound()) with clean server/client boundaries and proper 404 and cache-failure handling. The main structural debt is a 455-line view-model god module and a home loader that ships the whole catalog to the client; everything else is review nits. I'd merge after a light round of cleanups.
